picks.title: Copper Drakes for Black Crystal Ore
picks.why: Black Crystal Ore is still the priciest ore by far, around 2,600 mesos each today (about 2,000 over the week). Copper Drakes are weak to ice, so I/L Wizards clear them fastest. Maladies in The Forest of Evil II drop it too if you're 55+.

picks.title: Fire Boars for four kinds of loot
picks.why: Almost everything a Fire Boar drops sells, and Iron Ore (about 310) is still the priciest common ore. Great for warriors and bowmen right after 2nd job.

picks.title: Stirges for Iron Ore early
picks.why: The earliest way to farm Iron Ore. Stirges fly, so ranged and magic attacks have it easiest. Transfer Area in the Kerning subway has them too.

picks.title: Bubblings for Mithril while you level
picks.why: You're already here for EXP from 15 to 20, so keep the ores. Mithril and Sapphire both sell for about 125 to 130 each, more than most drops this low.

tips: Check what things actually sold for, not what people ask in megaphones. Asking prices run high.
Look at two sites before you sell anything rare. If they disagree, the lower number is closer to what you'll get.
Keep ores, leather and screws. Players pay far more than NPCs do.

Got a Piece of Ice, Fairy Wing or Moon Rock? Those are the priciest crafting materials on this page (about 70,000, 60,000 and 22,000 mesos today; Piece of Ice was nearer 45,000 over the week). Sell them to players, never to an NPC.
Most ores kept sliding: Garnet Ore is about 120 now (220 on Oct 23) and Mithril about 125 (230). Sell as you go instead of sitting on a big stack waiting for a bounce.
Undercut by a little, not a lot. A few mesos under the cheapest shop is enough to sell fast.
